title: Thermoviscous remagnetization of the Nama Group: model code and derived data
description: Code and derived data reproducing Figs 3-7 and Tables S1-S7 of the manuscript 'Slow cooling and the geomagnetic polarity history link protracted thermoviscous remagnetization to superchrons' (submitted to Geophysical Journal International): TROUT unmixing and specimen selection, RSCM band fitting, thermoviscous reset, continuous-cooling blocking ages and reversal-coherence filter.
